Subject: Post-demo: Multiregion Evaluation Plan & Model Recommendations

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we can start the evaluation on your datasets.

Key takeaways from the call:
- Primary locales: EU (DE, FR, NL) and APAC (JA, KO).
- Non-functional: P95 latency target ~<300ms for user-facing generation; batch/async ok for background tasks.
- Data residency: EU-only for EuraCorp production; pilot dataset can be shared cross-region.
- Acceptance criteria: >92% pass on your quality rubric for FR/DE; no regressions on brand-safety and entity preservation.

Model recommendations (initial sweep):
- EU (FR/DE/NL): Start with a mid-sized instruction-tuned multilingual 33B variant for highest quality, plus a quantized 7B candidate for latency-bound endpoints.
- APAC (JA/KO): 13B multilingual base quantized to q4_0 provides the best tradeoff (we've seen strong tokenization and generation fidelity on ja/ko).
- Fallback strategy: canonical English model (smaller) + locale-specific decoder finetune if we see consistent failure modes.

Attached: redwood_model_recs.pdf summarizing benchmarks we referenced, plus two prompt sets (eura_sample_prompts.csv and apex_japanese_sample.json). Links to our shared benchmark dashboards are below.

Proposed evaluation runbook (high level):
1) You grant sample data access (S3 or Drive).
2) We run an initial model sweep against your prompt set (3–4 candidate model variants).
3) We produce per-locale PR metrics (accuracy, hallucination rate, entity preservation) + latency cost estimates.
4) Decision: pick one model to pilot in dedicated EU region (if compliance required) or a hybrid route.

Timeline suggestion: if we get samples by EOD Wed (2026-07-08), we can deliver initial sweep results by end of week (2026-07-10) and a formal recommendation the following week.

Ask: please confirm the dataset share method (S3 bucket ARN or Drive link), any redlines on tokens retention, and the list of evaluation owners on your side.

Best,
Rachel
